selection_rationale: Paired per-fold comparison, simplest first; a more complex family must beat the incumbent by more than the std of the per-fold gap. lightgbm vs logistic_regression: -0.0510 +/- 0.1042 per fold [-0.2142, 0.0088, -0.0252, 0.0888, -0.113] -> keep logistic_regression. Selected logistic_regression. Features: 12 of 15 raw after selection.
cv_strategy: 5-fold expanding-window TimeSeriesSplit on time-sorted train (entities can appear on both sides of a fold boundary, as they do across train/test)
notes: Feature selection: work/feature_selection.py -> outputs/model/feature_selection.json (rule 'mean', redundancy removed []). Winner's validation-fold predictions: outputs/model/cv_predictions.parquet (for choosing a threshold without test). Winner CV: roc_auc 0.9800, precision_at_top_1pct 0.5615, recall_at_top_1pct 0.4774. Test split not used.
